pages.text: With Quantum Foundations done, research $(thing)The Casimir Effect$() next: 5 Insight and 4 $(item)Cherenkov Quartz$(). Its derivation uses symbols you learn by $(thing)holding an item$() once: $(thing)ħ$() (reduced Planck constant) from $(item)Cherenkov Quartz$(); $(thing)∫ f dx$() (integral) from $(item)Degenerate Matter Chunk$(). It unlocks the recipes of the Casimir Vacuum Press and the Zero-Point Energy Extractor.

Meanwhile, make $(item)Spacetime Casings$() - the frame of most machines - on the Extreme Assembly Table: 36 $(item)Neutronium Ingot$(), 36 $(item)Cherenkov Quartz$(), 9 $(item)Ender Pearl$() (makes 4). The rings of Observatory Ruins are made of them too: a pickaxe takes them.
